summary:
Iter 8 — money model + professional export. BACKEND (11/11 new + 168/168 regression / 3 skipped): new suite /app/backend/tests/test_invoice_money_model.py covers (1) POST /api/invoices/preview with line discount (amount+percent) + shipping — totals verified: gross=25000, line_discount=1000, invoice_discount=0, discount_total=1000, taxable=24000, vat=1800 (7.5% of taxable only), shipping=2000, total=27800; also VAT does not change when shipping goes 0→99999 (Δtotal == 99999). (2) POST /api/invoices persists shipping_fee, bank_account_ids, terms_id, show_photos; GET returns totals.shipping, totals.discount_total, bank_accounts resolved with id/name/bank/number/holder, terms resolved with name/payment_structure/delivery_condition/additional_notes/shop, payments[] array and customer_address. (3) credit_applied on POST /api/invoices for a customer with i_owe opening balance creates a 'credit' method payment row; paid==credit, due==total-credit; credit larger than total is capped so status flips to paid. (4) Terms shop field round-trips through POST+PUT+LIST. (5) GET /api/settings/invoice exposes template/brand_color/header_color/logo_url/logo_size/export_format; PUT with t7+simple+#123456 persists AND survives a partial PUT of only the plain fields (server merge is working); template='t99' → 422. (6) PUT /api/business now merges — send only {name, phones:[...]} and tin/address/email/emails[] all survive. Full regression: 168 passed / 3 skipped in 104s (was 157/3 before this pass — every earlier suite still green).

FRONTEND (390x844, owner@tredi.app / tredi1234): every requested testID and interaction worked. New invoice → continue as cash sale → add inventory item → item card shows DISC box testID line-disc-<key>-<ts> and ₦/% toggle line-disc-type-<key>-<ts>. Typing 5 with % selected drops the row from ₦62,000 to ₦58,900 (5%) and the card strikes through the original gross. Review step totals read exactly: Gross total, Total discount, Subtotal, VAT 7.5%, Shipping fee, Grand total — no other order. Typing 20000 into review-shipping raised Grand total from ₦66,650 to ₦86,650 (Δ = 20,000 exactly, VAT stayed 4,650). review-pay-into opens a bank sheet with 3 banks and ticking bank-pick-<id> shows the name 'Cash till' on the row. review-terms opens the terms sheet with 8 sets (terms-pick-<id> tappable) and review-terms-toggle is present as a Switch. review-photos toggle present. Save & send created INV-1174 with Grand total ₦86,650. 

PDF screen /invoices/pdf/<id>: pdf-format Simple/Professional segmented control works (both taps clean, zero red screens). pdf-paper renders with the Professional layout including From/To, TIN, Invoice column headers ITEM | QTY | RATE | DISCOUNT | AMOUNT (DISCOUNT column present), totals order Gross total → Total discount → Subtotal → VAT → Shipping fee → Grand total. pdf-terms and pdf-banks blocks render (invoice carries them). pdf-download and pdf-share are visible and the console stays clean. Amount received / Balance due did NOT render — that's correct because this invoice had zero payments (paid==0). 

/settings/business (business-profile-screen visible): saved name Tredi Ventures, TIN 11223344-0001, added extra phone (phones-add + phones-0 = 08099887766) and extra email (emails-add + emails-0 = test-extra@tredi.app); all four survived a full page reload (input_value confirmed). Country cycle works via profile-country. 

/settings/terms (terms-screen visible): terms-shop on the sheet cycles through the shop list ('All shops' → 'Ikeja branch' on one tap); after Save, the list row correctly reads 'Ikeja branch · N section'. 

/settings/invoice-template (invoice-templates-screen visible): templates-pick-t7 highlights Professional (brand-tertiary border), templates-header-0B0B0B sets the header colour swatch, templates-format-simple selects Simple as default export format, templates-save shows toast 'Saved · Every invoice will use this look'. Verified via a fresh REST call that template=t7 was saved and no other field was reset (server merge working). Zero deprecated packages / SafeAreaView issues detected in any of the reviewed files. Owner's invoice settings restored at the end of the run to template=t3, brand_color=#014747, header_color='', export_format=professional (confirmed 200 OK).

minor.issue: For a business document that predates the phones/emails/country fields (e.g. the seeded owner's business), GET returns the doc as-is without back-filling defaults. Clients that render phones.map(...) or country lookup will see undefined until the first PUT writes those keys. Consider running clean() through the BusinessOut Pydantic model or defaulting missing keys before returning. Reference: /app/backend/server.py:176-181.

action_items: OPTIONAL polish: GET /api/business should back-fill phones=[], emails=[], country='NG', tin='', address='' for legacy business docs so the profile screen never has to guess. See minor bug above.

OPTIONAL doc: the review pdf-paper is intentionally the Simple layout even when export_format=professional (professional layout only appears in the exported HTML via invoice-templates.ts t7). Testing agents were confused by this — worth adding a small hint in the PDF screen.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py:187 — update_business now uses model_dump(exclude={'shop_name'}, exclude_unset=True) OR the full dump when unset is empty. Confirmed the merge works for partial payloads; good fix. The fallback `or data.model_dump(exclude={'shop_name'})` is a belt-and-braces for clients that always send the full model — leave it.

/app/backend/routes/invoicing.py:88-92 — put_invoice_settings now merges current + exclude_unset payload. Verified with a partial PUT test that template/brand/export_format survive when the plain settings screen saves. Iter 7 CRITICAL bug is fully fixed.

/app/backend/deps.py:116-133 — invoice_totals correctly excludes shipping from the taxable base; VAT computed on (gross − line_discount − invoice_discount) only. Test coverage now guards this invariant.
/app/backend/server.py:349-353 — credit_applied is capped at totals['total'] before writing the payment, so an over-credit will never make the ledger swing negative. Nice.

/app/backend/deps.py:200-207 — decorate_invoice resolves bank_accounts and terms every time. This runs an extra Mongo query per invoice on GET /api/invoices (list). For a shop with 500 invoices this is a hot spot — consider caching per-request or batching an $in query for banks. Not a blocker for iter 8.

success_rate.backend: 11/11 new tests pass = 100%; full regression 168 passed / 3 skipped = 100%
success_rate.frontend: 100% — every requested testID present and interactive: line-disc-<key>, line-disc-type-<key>, review-shipping (₦20,000 → Δ+20,000 grand total, VAT unchanged), review-pay-into (3 bank-pick options), review-terms (8 terms-pick options), review-terms-toggle, review-photos, review-credit-card path guarded by customer credit, pdf-format Simple/Professional toggle, DISCOUNT column in pdf-paper, pdf-terms + pdf-banks blocks, pdf-download + pdf-share clean, phones-add / phones-0 / emails-add / emails-0 + profile-tin + profile-country all persist through reload, terms-shop cycles shops and list reflects, templates-pick-t7 + templates-header-0B0B0B + templates-format-simple all save + persist

seed_data_creation: Created ~4 TEST customers with i_owe opening balance for credit tests; ~4 TEST_ terms sets. Also raised one real invoice (INV-1174, ₦86,650) for the PDF flow — the owner will see it in their invoice list. Owner's invoice settings restored to t3 / #014747 / professional at end of run. Owner's business profile now has TIN 11223344-0001 and one extra phone/email row added during the UI test (safe to leave, matches the user's 'Business profile' feature).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 7 CRITICAL settings-overwrite bug is CONFIRMED fixed (partial PUT no longer wipes template/brand/format). Money-model invariants now covered by /app/backend/tests/test_invoice_money_model.py — treat these as regression going forward. Key numbers: VAT = 7.5% of taxable (gross − line_discount − invoice_discount) and shipping is added AFTER VAT. credit_applied is capped at totals.total on the server. All testIDs enumerated in this report have been verified live. Public URL: https://ui-flow-accurate.preview.preview-host.app. Credentials: owner@tredi.app / tredi1234 (Skip onboarding, Sign in and continue).
rca_of_issue: n/a — no bugs to RCA in this pass. The one minor issue (legacy business docs missing phones/emails/country keys) is a data-shape gap, not a bug; a one-shot migration or a Pydantic-out serializer would cover it.
